The '''77th [[Writers Guild of America Awards]]''' was held on February 15, 2025, to honor the best writing in film, television and radio of 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Lewis |first=Hilary |date=January 15, 2025 |title=2025 Writers Guild Awards Nominations: ''Challengers,'' ''My Old Ass,'' ''A Complete Unknown,'' ''Dune: Part Two'' Among Films Nominated |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/2025-writers-guild-awards-nominations-nominees-list-1236109708/ |access-date=January 15, 2025 |website=The Hollywood Reporter |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Richlin |first=Harrison |date=January 15, 2025 |title=2025 WGA Award Nominees Include ''A Real Pain,'' ''Anora,'' ''Wicked,'' and More |url=https://www.indiewire.com/awards/results/2025-wga-award-nominations-full-list-1235084627/ |access-date=January 15, 2025 |website=IndieWire |language=en-US}}</ref> The nominations were announced on January 15, 2025. The Writers Guild originally scheduled to announce the nominations on January 9, but they postponed them twice due to the [[January 2025 Southern California wildfires|series of wildfires affecting Southern California]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Davis |first=Clayton |date=January 9, 2025 |title=WGA Awards Nominations Postponed to Jan. 13 Amid L.A. Fires |url=https://variety.com/2025/film/news/wga-awards-nominations-postponed-1236270515/ |access-date=January 15, 2025 |website=Variety |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Hipes |first=Patrick |date=January 13, 2025 |title=WGA Awards Postpones Nominations Announcement Again Due To L.A. Wildfires – Update |url=https://deadline.com/2025/01/wga-awards-nominations-postponed-los-angeles-fires-1236252192/ |access-date=January 15, 2025 |website=Deadline |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Winners and nominees ==

Winners are listed first in boldface.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Schneider|first1=Michael|last2=Maas|first2=Jennifer|title='Shogun,' 'Hacks,' 'Anora,' 'Nickel Boys' Land Top Honors at Writers Guild Awards 2025 (Full Winners List)|url=https://variety.com/2025/film/awards/writers-guild-wga-awards-2025-winners-list-1236309307/|date=February 15, 2025|access-date=February 17, 2025|website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref>
